nom: Peter Thomas Roth Instant FIRMx Eye Temporary Eye Tightener Easy-Wear Formula

avis.texte: I love this product it lasts all day and does the job!! Then a little face make up looks great.. It can flake a little after applied once tried a little warm water all good. Wash the brush and let it air dry.. Product is a MUST BUY you won't regret it
The appearance of my under eye did not change as was advertised I returned it.

I tried this every way it was recommended. Nothing worked. It does decrease the puffiness under your eye but you cannot wear makeup over it or under it. It separates the makeup and looks terrible. Without makeup it is white under your eyes. I tried oil free moisturizer and makeup. Neither made a difference.Very disappointed.

This product definitely works, but after using it 3 days, the 4th day I couldn't wash it off fast enough. It BURNED! And for 4 days after that (and not using it) the skin under my eyes was so tender and dry. Maybe it works for others, definitely not for me.
This really works. You just need to realize that you don't need a lot and learn how to apply it correctly. Understand what TEMPORARY means and you will give this product 5 stars.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: Works especially well under the eyes.You can actually feel it, tightening up those bags that hang out under the eyes.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy the product again.
avis.texte: I have been using Peter Thomas Roth for years and I've been satisfied with the cream. I don't mind traveling to get to the store, even though I have the option to order online. On my next visit I would like to look into hand cream or facial wash. Thank you

I didn't believe it was true until I tried it for myself. Took 10 years off my face! You have to let it dry thoroughly. It's tinted, so I did not need concealer or bb cream in that area. Definitely recommend.

avis.titre: Peter Thomas Roth instant eye firming cream
avis.texte: I don't know how this product has only received 3.7 average stars. Which is why I don't always go by that when I look for products. I bought this by accident as I was returning another Korean product that didn't do anything for me! Best spur of the moment purchase I've ever made and I will be buying this routinely

avis.titre: Use just a little and you'll love this
avis.texte: I have hollow undereyes and bags; I wear progressives and my underyes are magnified. I really like this product - use very little and I think you will love it, too. I think it works well under makeup, too.

I trued this product yeaterday for the first time. I didnt really notice a difference. Today i decided to take before and after pics. I put the cream on and waited about 5 minutes. Today the results were obvious. I have extreme puffiness and it was mostly gone! However as soon as I put on my foundation, the results were completely gone! I read in other comments that it does not work with liquid foundation. It's useless then! I'm not convinced that it would have lasted long without adding the foundation. I wouldn't waste my money again!

I put some on.. it was tightening. I looked abd it was what?? All gone. Came back in 5 more to check and it was back. Im not keeping. Returning to Ulta. Never wanted something to work so badly. I wish Premier still sold their's. It stayed all day.
Does not work at all. I hoped I finally found one that worked. No!!!
Felt my skin tightening, but about minutes after it was back to normal

avis.titre: Wasted my money on this one!
avis.texte: No matter what I do to this product, it leaves a dry film where I apply it & have to wash it off & start over with out it. Maybe I'm doing something wrong, but I have tried everything.

This works great, I use it and it firms up the underside of my eyes. You have to adjust how much to use tho. This tightening cream is only 1 oz as compared to the same one- 2 oz- without the color in it.

avis.titre: I will definitely buy again & again!
avis.texte: This new version of this product is so much better than the original product. It goes on easy, doesn't get white specks or a thin white coating, and lasts until I wash it off in the evening.
After using for a couple days my eyes were irradiated and red. I had to stop using it. I want to return it since it cost a lot of money
Leaves a white film on your face; this is not for all skin types. Not for brown skin types.

I have use the older product they made and it was tricky to work with and at times left a white haze. This product works great and I have yet to have an issue. I love applying it with the new brush included. Goes on super smooth and really works! Probably one of the best of these products I've ever used.
Not impressed. Does not reduce the under eye area like the original Peter Roth Thmoas Eye Firming eye tighter.
Love, love, love it. It was amazing watching the under eye circles and puffiness disappear.

avis.titre: I will definitely buy again & again!

After using for a couple days my eyes were irradiated and red. I had to stop using it. I want to return it since it cost a lot of money
Leaves a white film on your face; this is not for all skin types. Not for brown skin types.

I have use the older product they made and it was tricky to work with and at times left a white haze. This product works great and I have yet to have an issue. I love applying it with the new brush included. Goes on super smooth and really works! Probably one of the best of these products I've ever used.
Not impressed. Does not reduce the under eye area like the original Peter Roth Thmoas Eye Firming eye tighter.

Im so upset! I have the original tightening cream and it left white residue... seen this NEWER supposed to be BETTER version and ordered it because they said there's no more reside but they lied... uughhh I want my money back!

This was great the first couple of uses, but now it leaves white specs all over my undereye. I have tried to shake the bottle and mix the product before applying, but it is all chunky. It is only 2 months old. Really disappointing for how pricey this is. Do not recommend.
Love, love, love it. It was amazing watching the under eye circles and puffiness disappear.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again!!!!
avis.texte: Would not buy this again did not work as, Ulta employee stated could use with makeup did not work.

This stuff works. You will erase years of wrinkles for a day. It has high potential for climbing, as in little white dots where there is too much product. So there is a learning curve. But I looked amazing! The real problem is the next day or week. I'm 7 days from using it. It's as if it sucked all moisture from under my eyes and I can't get it back I now look older than ever. I've been moisturizing like crazy day and night. It's super saggy and crepey and delicate skin now. I really regret using it.

avis.titre: Why didn't anyone tell me about this product sooner??
avis.texte: I am in my 40's and definitely noticing the skin around my eyes aging and looking puffy in the morning. After applying this product I notice a huge difference in minutes! It smoothes out puffiness and takes years off my aging eyes! My only complaint is that it does not mix well with liquid makeup so I had to start using a powder foundation, but I'll take it to look a few years younger!

avis.titre: I wouldn't purchase this product again.
avis.texte: I purchased this quite a while ago. It does not make a noticeable differences on my under eye bags. The product leaves a white chalky film that I can't brush away, it needs to be cleaned off with water. If you have improved your product, are you willing to replace or refund.

avis.titre: The ONLY Eye Tightener that has worked for me
avis.texte: I've purchased a couple of eye tighteners in the past, but none of them worked at all. I was skeptical about this tiny little tube at first, but I can feel it working and tightening my under eye skin almost immediately. It is now a part of my go-to morning routine. It doesn't take a lot of product to work either, and so 1 tube lasts me for 3-4 months. Give it a try. It's worth the price tag.

Key word here is temporary. This feels like rubber cement/glue under your eyes. I don't have ultra baggy under eyes but really wanted to see the hype with this product. And I will say it's definitely not worth it. You apply it and within seconds feel it tightening but you can feel the product on your face and after a while it gets a little flaky/crusty. If you applied makeup on over it, it would def crack. Love PTR the brand otherwise but this product wasn't it for me. Not worth it. Returned.
I try to use as little as possible, but it still leaves a white film Around my eyes And by using less, it works less

I am loyal customer of the original eye tightener, so I was hesitant about buying this cause I had an extra tube on hand. Well I shouldn't have hesitated. This is even better than the original. You can layer it if you didn't put on enough, it doesn't leave any whiteness… it's just better than the original! And I loved the original!. It feels comfortable and light putting on. I just love it. Please do not hesitate to get this, it is life-changing!
Works, but I always have dryness under eyes with white particles.is this normal?
Tried every way recommended. It did tighten but left a white residue. I tried before make up. After makeup. No make up. No lotion. With lotion. Always had the flaky white stuff one point it burned.

I have liked most PTR products and tried the previous version of this & didn't like the white. I forgot that once it works, you cannot put makeup over it; you lose all tightening affects. I'm in no place to leave the house makeup-less.

I thought this was gonna be so good. Better than the one I was currently using. However, after several times of applying it, in all different kinds of ways, white dots are left around the area. It's Applied. I could not remove the white dots without removing the product. I did exactly with the direction sent. I even went online to find out other ways to apply. Nothing helped remove or prevent the white dots. It's a shame because it would be a good product if not for that. Unless I got a defective one, this is not worth the money.

avis.titre: Not good for true eye bags
avis.texte: I dont any wrinkles just a eye bag with a true fat pad and it didnt do much of anything for that it did tighten some of the creases i have under my eyes but thats about it. Dries your undereyes out bad. And peels. Ive tried to wear it under makeup and it peels everytime no matter what i try but i also use alot of concealer and foundation so maybe if you just used a BB cream you could pull it off.
This worked very well the only downfall is you can't put makeup over it cuz then it doesn't work anymore, and if you put it over makeup it turns totally White looks stupid

Read the descriptions! This one only "blurs" the eye puffiness and the original temporarily gets rid of eye puffiness. The original works much better, even though it is white and takes a few times to learn how to apply it. The new formula is a nude skin tone and is more creamy. I'm going back to the original since I have used it for 4 yrs.
This product is awful. White spots appear no matter how I apply.

I honestly did not think this product would work. Boy, was I wrong! I don't mind looking in the mirror anymore! It was recommended I purchase this product with a tint. It's fine but I wish I could have tested the untinted to compare. Bottom line, still so happy with this product. Not inexpensive but so worth it!

I love everything else I purchased from this brand so I had high hopes. I felt like the brush it comes with would be a bonus. Unfortunately, this product creates piles or little balls, especially when using the brush. I find it easier to tap it into the skin very very lightly with a very thin layer and make sure not to rub the area or touch the area once the product is on. I see a slight difference under my eye, but not enough to offset the irritating piles or balls of product and dry looking white areas that it creates. Add don't even touch of water to that spots that are white helps a little but really this shouldn't happen. It didn't irritate my skin and it doesn't have a strong smell so I think I'll try my best to finish off the tube so it's not a waste of money. I love so many of their other products though for this brand.
Didn't like it, it leaves residue no matter how much or how little you use. And cant wear it under make up either.

I was hesitant to purchase this but did anyway. It definitely delivers. It has raised my hooded eye lids, erased the wrinkles on my forehead and under eye area. Also, it works for me either under or over makeup. Ordering more!!
Tried this product three times now with no visible results. It doesn't cover my skin. Watery at best. Just another waste of money.

When I bought this product I was very excited. Upon using this product it did what is said. It reduced the puffiness but however it did leave a white residue under my eyes where I applied it. I tried using less the same thing. I even wer the brush, the same thing. For the amount of money that I spent i wish that I was able to have tried it out before I purchased it.
This product leaves a an orange is film under the eye. I even purchased the new and improved claiming it wouldn't leave that film. Wrong. I had to wash it off.

avis.titre: Amazing results! You just have to use it correctly.
avis.texte: It's like an upper bleph without the surgery. It will not work if you slather on moisturizer or any kind of makeup primer. I apply a very small amount with a brush immediately after I wash and dry my face. I let it do its thing for 10-15 minutes. I then apply facial moisturizer to my face but not my eyelids. I finish with a light dusting of eye shadow and end with mascara. I feel much more awake all day because I don't have droopy eyelids!

avis.titre: I will buy this product again.
avis.texte: I tried this new product and I am getting the results it claimed. I am happy with my purchase.

Simply don't waste your money i am been thinking last many months to try or not, today i just get it it's not working maybe work on swollen eyes but not on eye bags at all and so flaky after drying it's new improved formula i am thinking if this one is then how bad the old one .

avis.titre: Does not work like original formula-Dont waste your money
avis.texte: This new easy wear formula is awful! It doesn't hold the way the original does. Within an hour my bags are back. I have been using the original eye tightening formula for years, and while that one can leave white residue if too much is applied, or if it gets wet, it holds alllll dang day! This one, I am so disappointed as I was excited to see there was a bit of color to it. I will NOT be repurchasing this new formula.
The product is better than the original, but it still doesn't take away the puffiness and it does leave some white spots so I returned it

This product provides excellent results when used properly. My friends asked if I had any work done and I'm thrilled to tell them no and share the info on this product with them. I've learned that there are tricks to using the product correctly and that less is definitely more. Occasionally I'll get traces of white, but I simply wipe it off and start again.
I thought I'd give this a try for my hooded eyes, it made it worse. I applied it three different times thinking maybe it was me, nope. I'll be returning.

It worked the first few times I used it. But, it has a weird feeling and it pills on your skin. Also, after about 3 months, it hardened in the container. Now I have to cut the tip off almost every time I want to use it.
Hi, don't waste your money on this product. it was supposed to be better than their previous one. Baloney! I still got the white residue and the puffiness remained. A true waste of money.

This does give an instant smoothing look to a puffy underage. However, it creates a dark film around where you apply it and makes it look weird. Im not sure if im just not using it right. May be its supposed to be worn under make up or may be I just got a wrong shade. I dont know. But if you had the right shade, it definitely helps remove the puffiness temporarily.

This does give an instant smoothing look to a puffy underage. However, it creates a dark film around where you apply it and makes it look weird. Im not sure if im just not using it right. May be its supposed to be worn under make up or may be I just got a wrong shade. I dont know. But if you had the right shade, it definitely helps remove the puffiness temporarily.
This stuff is amazing and it works great. Just make sure to only use a small amount.

Absolutely amazing. I've been dragging my feet going out to get this and I finally did. Believe the hype. As a man with under eye bags that I usually treat with ice for 15 mins everyday this product works instantly. Recommend highly. 10 of 10
I just had a friend ask me if I had "work done" because I look younger suddenly!

This worked well, but by the 2rd day of using it, it burned so bad! it did subside after a minute or so, but still seems unsafe, for my skin anyway. At 46 years old, Ive never considered myself to have "sensitive skin."
yes temporarily fixes bags under eyes but still leaves residue. If I didn't throw away box I would have returned

avis.titre: Great, drying time was quite quick!
avis.texte: It works great, no white cast. It lasted all day about 9 hours.

avis.titre: I would buy this product but not for awhile it's expensive
avis.texte: I love Peter Thomas Roth instant eye tightner but this last purchase I was not happy with this product the black tube was now silver not black n less in the tube n this product is much more expensive than Plexaderm which I might start ordering

avis.titre: Perfect if you don't wear makeup
avis.texte: This product works and fast and makes a huge improvement I love this part as I don't wear makeup often but when i was wanting to have a night out and put on makeup before I arrived my face looked so awful I decided to go home. So i am confused on how to use this, maybe only summertime when I don't use anything but sunscreen, i am at a loss on how to wear this product and disappointed because it works alone , not how I wanted to use it
It is way too drying to put around your eyes. Horrible stuff

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again.
avis.texte: You cannot not wear make up under it or over it. It cause's everything to dry out, leaving flakes and spots.
I bought this cause I've used PTR products & always lived them... thos does not work. no matter how little you use, there is a white residue,
This brand is a favorite of mine, but this product does not do as well as the firm under eye application that leaves a white patch.

This had real results. Took me completely by surprise to actually watch in the mirror the bags under my eyes vanish within minutes. There is a "tight" feeling that may occur but will pass. I've read several of the negative reviews and I believe some (not alll) stem from not following the instructions or having sensitive skin. Just my own thoughts.

I've been using this product for years and love it! It really works and lasts a long time, which is what we're all looking for, isn't it? 😁⭐️ I've read so many complaints about flakiness, but in reality, they weren't using it properly! What I do is sparingly apply my regular eye cream, let it absorb, then use a pea- sized amount of product onto my finger. I then use half of that amount on each eye. It works so well!! You have to play with it to see what works for you, but it's truly an awesome product, and is much more effective than Clarins!!! Work with it and it will work for you! I hope that this helps 😘🩷

avis.titre: New formula is for superior to original!
avis.texte: This new easy to wear formula is far superior than the original! I've been using the original for over a year, and I used to mix it with the primer to try to help the white residue issue, but every day was still a struggle. I've been amazed at how easy it has been to apply this new improved easy to wear formula. I have not had any white residue and I don't need to wipe it off and put it back on several times as I did with the original. I highly recommend it. I have loss of elasticity under my eyes with a little puffiness and it tightens it right up!
Leaves white cast and feels uncomfortable. I threw both cubes on the trash.

Read directions & follow them! It really did make my fine lines seem less noticeable & eyes were less puffy. I don't like that when you put makeup on, effects don't last as long. They need to make it compatible for makeup users. or make it tinted.
I received my product yesterday tried it today and I love the way its got rid of my bags and dark circles. Best product to get rid of wrinkles and eye bags I've ever used
I dont this this product if for people of color. First when it dried it looked like snot on my face.

I knew going into this product it lasts approx 5-6hrs, which honestly was just the right amount of time. So I use it under a tinted moisturizer. It works great! It does leave a few white specks on my skin…but they are not a big issue … I just wipe them off. So for my casual needs, this product is just perfect!

avis.titre: I would NOT BUY THIS AGAIN!
avis.texte: I keep trying these products after seeing them on line. They still have not taken care of the white residue it leaves behind, even though they said they had. Tired of wasting my money.
I am on my second tube and Love this product. This is the best ever.
It wss not laying under my concealor well. It left strange white flakes.

avis.titre: If you have sensitive skin, do not buy this
avis.texte: I wanted to love it because I love all the other products I have from It, but it burned my skin so bad within seconds, I washed it off. My skin was super sensitive for hours after. I returned it.
Does not work. Do not waste your money. Just leaves a brown film under eye

The eye tightener works. Drawback for me is that when I carefully put my concealer under my eye after applying the FIRMx, I seemed to break the stiffness of the tightener. I played with different techniques to apply the eye concealer over the FIRMx, but the FIRMx only worked for a few hours. It's not an all day thing.

This deal is definitely not in the bag! I wanted to let this product so when my daughter surprise me with this for Christmas, I was happy to try. I followed the directions precisely. I tried it with and without makeup, and although it gave me that tight feeling, I didn't notice a difference in the appearance of the bags, and there was still residue, even though I used the small amount you could see it even through the make up.

First, I would not have bought this had I known you were not supposed to put make up on top of it. Second, it leaves a white shadow. No matter how little you use, the white residue appears and if you try to get it off, it gets worse & pills.

I bought this product a week ago. I was very excited to use it and have it a part of my life. I'm so disappointed and stressed because it leaves a white residue after it dries. Now my money has been wasted

This product is beyond amazing! The results are too good to be true but they are! It removes crows feet around the eyes and bags under the eyes and also tightens the skin above the eye lids. I love this product! You won't be disappointed if you give it a try!
While it did "tighten" the under-eye area, the color of the product on skin made it very obvious that I had a product on. No matter how little I applied, the color was a total turn-off.

Saw this on TikTok, immediately purchased it. It's like a magic trick. It did take a few applications for me to get it just right. I love this stuff. I have almond eyes as I'm half Korean and it works wonders on the bags under my eyes.

avis.titre: I wouldn't waste my money on this product
avis.texte: It left residue even with small application. Bags were still visible.
Do not buy its crap leaves face DRY and white and I blotted off excess. It's the new version and don't waste that much money on something you will not be happy with
Waste of money. It does tighten the skin but once you start moving your face/have expressions it looks terrible....

I want to start off by saying I did not purchase this product from Ulta. My husband got it for me as a gift and honestly I do not know where he ordered it from all I can say is it was the name brand product I used it twice and was fine the third time I used it it left a bright red mark under my eye it burnt when I applied it and left a white residue so I ended up wiping it off the next day I woke up with a burn mark and my eyes swelled up
Does not work under makeup or on top of makeup. Leaves white residue waste of money

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] At 50 years old, I'm always looking for products to give my skin a tighter, more youthful appearance. I feel like this was successful in tightening a bit, but nothing earth shattering. I also tried it on my husband who has visible eye bags and considerably more wrinkling - it didn't do much for him either. What I found most disappointing with this is that despite following the directions closely, this really didn't perform well under makeup. The skin was super dry and cracked.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Instant firm x by Peter Thomas Roth works as it says. I saw a noticeable difference in the smoothness of my under eye area. It does feel weird at first as it tightens but then you barely notice it. I do wish it lasted a little longer. Overall it's a good product and will definitely improve your look. Great to have before pictures and special events.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Instant rejuvenation effect. Moisturizes and nourishes the skin around the eyes, smoothing wrinkles, bags under the eyes, dark circles. Comes with a brush. Applies perfectly without streaks and lumps. Absorbs well. Tube 20 ml. Affordable price.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Tired eyes that need a pick me up? Why yes, that is my eyes. They definitely need a pick me up after 2 kids. This serum truly does firm and lift your eyes giving it a true pump up desired look. The serum is light and you can feel the cool little tingle as it starts to work. I am more than happy to add this to my skincare routine!

avis.titre: I would buy again and again
avis.texte: I love this product even though its drying... Hopefully it doesnt pull the bags down undereye further from use but I tend to hydrate afterwards. Makes me look younger/awake
